subject: ela
cluster: Research to build and present knowledge
intro: Remember the fact and pick the answer.

items.prompt:
Read.

We learned that cows give us milk.

What do cows give us?
A) Eggs
B) Milk
C) Wool

steps: Recall the fact. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Read.

We read that bees live in a hive.

Where do bees live?

B) A nest
C) A cave

steps: Recall the fact. Key is A.

items.prompt:
If you forget a fact, you can:
A) Look back at the book
B) Make it up
C) Give up
items.answer: A) Look back at the book

solution.answer: A) Look back at the book
